R1.stage_scope: These are actual logged gradient norms and learning-rate sums. Fusion has no direct word-alignment loss, so its nonzero gradients establish generation-loss backpropagation while Wan LoRA is frozen. Enhancement gradients combine generation and word losses and do not isolate their contributions. Learning-rate sums are schedule exposure, not equivalent Adam updates, compute or quality. This does not establish that128 interface steps are optimal or that the stage schedule causes SA loss.
R1.scope: Training diagnostics, not SA/PC proxies; only matched input windows are compared.
